This pathway implies that Bupropion may influence Cyp2e1 through its interaction with Etoricoxib, potentially altering the metabolic processing of drugs. The evidence highlights a mechanistic link where Bupropion indirectly affects Cyp2e1 via Etoricoxib, though the exact nature of this interaction remains unclear. The strength of the evidence is moderate, as it relies on indirect connections and does not provide direct evidence of a direct interaction between Bupropion and Cyp2e1. The observed scores suggest a moderate level of confidence in this relationship, but further experimental validation would be necessary to confirm the proposed mechanism.
